scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind algorithms as everyday instructions.
Algorithm: is an ordered set of steps to solve a task. Sequence: puts instructions in the right order.
Repeat: does an instruction again. Condition: chooses an action based on a test. Debugging: looks for and fixes errors in instructions.
Design a simple paper model explaining algorithm, sequence and repeat. Trade models with a classmate and explain how your design works.
